decision.reason: China Securities Journal Oct 14 interviewed film, platform and model companies: scripts, narration, acting and human QC remain bottlenecks even as image and shot generation are automated. A no-ML shot continuity human-approval register is a hypothesis; competition will be tested later.
decision.article_title: AI漫剧行情升温 探访影视行业生产变局 - 中国经济网

opportunities.idea_name: AI Film Shot Continuity QC Ledger
opportunities.core_job: Track AI-assisted short film and animation shots through script coverage, continuity checks, human approvals and release exceptions
opportunities.target_customer: Animation and short-form film studios with AI-assisted video production
opportunities.product_mechanism: Scene/shot board → character/prop continuity checklist → input image/model output provenance references → human reviewer issue/action → final acceptance and export
opportunities.why_now: 2026-10-14 China Securities Journal reports AI-augmented micro drama/comics expanding to long-form productions while narrative, acting, screenplay and quality still require professional human control
opportunities.before_state: AI-generated shot versions and story/edit continuity feedback scattered across folders, chats and editors
opportunities.after_state: Versioned scene-to-shot asset index, reviewer QC issues, continuity acceptance and signed release evidence
